name: Havana 1920
notes: 3 photos: 1 and 2 are duplicate shots (different angles) of the same full printed food menu, merged into one list; 3 is a rum list (alcohol-only), skipped per rules.

dishes.name: Havana Bocaditos Platter
dishes.description: Fried green plantains, chicken croquettes (2), cheese stuffed potato, picadillo stuffed potato, ham & cheese empanada, & vegetarian empanada

dishes.name: Croqueta de Pollo
dishes.description: Chicken croquette made with roasted chicken & creamy bechamel

dishes.name: Croqueta de Jamon y Queso
dishes.description: Ham and cheese croquette made with ham, Swiss cheese, & creamy bechamel

dishes.name: Papa Rellena de Queso
dishes.description: Cheese stuffed potato: mashed potato ball stuffed with Havana cheese blend & peppers, fried to a golden brown

dishes.name: Papa Rellena de Carne
dishes.description: Picadillo stuffed potato: mashed potato ball stuffed with seasoned ground beef hash, fried to a golden brown

dishes.name: Empanada de Jamon y Queso
dishes.description: Ham & cheese turnover: savory pastry filled with ham & Swiss cheese

dishes.name: Empanada La Cubanita
dishes.description: Cuban sandwich turnover: savory pastry filled with slow roasted pork, ham, Swiss cheese, & pickles, served with mustard

dishes.name: Empanada de Carne
dishes.description: Picadillo turnover: savory pastry filled with ground beef hash

dishes.name: Empanada Vegetariana
dishes.description: Vegetarian turnover: savory pastry filled with spinach, mint, dill, onions, mushrooms, & feta cheese

dishes.name: Camarones al Ajillo
dishes.description: Shrimp in garlic sauce: mushrooms, capers, white wine, garlic, & fresh lemon juice, served with a side of toasted Cuban bread

dishes.name: Yuca Frita
dishes.description: Yuca fries: yuca root boiled then lightly fried to a golden brown

dishes.name: Platanos Maduros
dishes.description: Fried sweet plantains, ripened & fried to perfection

dishes.name: Arroz y Frijoles Negros
dishes.description: White rice & black beans

dishes.name: Tostones Rellenos
dishes.description: Stuffed green plantain platter: 3 plantain cups filled with Ropa Vieja, Pollo al Ajillo, & Lechon Asado

dishes.name: Tostones
dishes.description: Fried green plantains, the Caribbean classic, flattened & twice fried

dishes.name: House Salad
dishes.description: Choice of dressing (garlic-lemon vinaigrette, aderezo casero, or ranch); Side $7 / Entree $11

dishes.name: Ensalada Habana
dishes.description: Havana salad: mixed greens, grilled pineapple, black beans, tomato, avocado, cucumber, & onion, drizzled with a garlic-lemon vinaigrette

dishes.name: Cubano
dishes.description: Cuban sandwich: slices of slow roasted pork, ham, Swiss cheese, pickles, & mustard pressed between slices of buttery Cuban bread

dishes.name: Pan con Bistec
dishes.description: Steak sandwich: grilled & marinated steak, potato sticks, Swiss cheese, tomato, & grilled onions pressed between slices of buttery Cuban bread

dishes.name: Ropa Vieja
dishes.description: Beef sandwich: shredded beef made with peppers, olives, & onions cooked in tomato sauce served with Swiss cheese pressed between slices of buttery Cuban bread

dishes.name: Birria Empanada
dishes.description: Crispy, golden, savory empanada filled with slow braised beef birria & melted mozzarella, served with a side of consome for dipping; 1 for $7, 2 for $13, 3 for $19

dishes.name: The Mexican Cuban
dishes.description: Twist on the classic Cuban sandwich, featuring slow braised beef birria, melted Swiss cheese, pickled jalapenos, & mustard, all pressed between crispy, buttery Cuban bread

dishes.name: Cuban Burrito
dishes.description: Lechon, white rice, black beans, Havana cheese blend, & avocado wrapped in a flour tortilla, served with a side of platanos maduros

dishes.name: Lechon Rolled Tacos
dishes.description: Shredded lettuce, Chingon cheese blend, Mexican citrus cream, avocado cream, pico de gallo, guacamole, cotija cheese; 3 for $10, 5 for $13, 12 for $21

dishes.name: Medio Pollo al Ajillo
dishes.description: Garlic half chicken: roasted chicken, marinated in a garlic-citrus mojo

dishes.name: Picadillo
dishes.description: Ground beef hash: ground beef, potatoes, onions, olives, raisins, & garlic cooked in tomato sauce

dishes.name: Ropa Vieja
dishes.description: Shredded beef in tomato: the national dish of Cuba, shredded beef with peppers, olives, & onions cooked in tomato sauce

dishes.name: Lechon Asado
dishes.description: Cuban style roasted pork, marinated in fresh citrus & garlic, then slow-roasted to perfection

dishes.name: Vaca Frita
dishes.description: Fried shredded beef: shredded & fried skirt steak topped with sauteed onions, served with limes

dishes.name: Bistec Havana
dishes.description: Havana steak: Angus skirt steak topped with house made chimichurri, served with toasted Cuban bread & a side salad

dishes.name: Panceta de Cerdo
dishes.description: Fried pork belly: tender, boneless cut pork with rich, savory flavors & a sweet-salty balance, served with a side of sofrito & limes

dishes.name: Filete Tomahawk
dishes.description: 32oz of certified Angus beef, grilled & topped with a mojo reduction butter & sauteed garlic
